methodology: Expand11 identity growth beyond dense majors. Prefer ProjectSAM / Impact Soundworks / Fracture Sounds / Keepforest as soundsets; AudioThing / Cableguys / Baby Audio / Goodhertz plugin+bundle gaps; Spitfire BBC/Abbey Shopify gaps as soundset; NI Leap/sounds Shopify gaps; EastWest 25th Anniversary; Modartt Champagne Flute; FOSS wolf-spectrum/wolf-shaper/ninjas2/fabla + rncbc v1 suite (padthv1/synthv1/samplv1/drumkv1). Dragonfly already dense+versioned; LSP dense; emotive-sounds skipped (no public SKU matrix). Dedup by manufacturer norm + id. No invented versions. No git clone.
